Name: farm-plot-selector
Commands:
turn off "EC Test Farm" farmplot
turn on "EC Test Farm" farmplot
if "EC Test Farm" farmplot is on
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: farm selector"

Name: algae-selector-and-output
Commands:
turn on "EC Test Algae" algaefarm
if "EC Test Algae" algaefarm output >= 0
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: algae output"

Name: food-processor-selector
Commands:
turn off "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor
turn on "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor
if "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor is on
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: food processor selector"

Name: seed-alias-transfer
Commands:
transfer 2 "fruit seeds" from "source cargo" to "destination cargo"
assign sourceCount to "source cargo" amount "fruit seeds"
assign destinationCount to "destination cargo" amount "fruit seeds"
if sourceCount is 3 and destinationCount is 2
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: seed transfer counts"

Name: irrigation-selector
Commands:
turn on "EC Test Irrigation" irrigation system
if "EC Test Irrigation" irrigation system is on
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: irrigation selector"

Name: empty-farm-crop-state
Commands:
assign ecOccupiedFlag to "EC Test Farm" farmplot occupied
assign ecLivingFlag to "EC Test Farm" farmplot crop alive
assign ecCropName to "EC Test Farm" farmplot crop
if ecOccupiedFlag or ecLivingFlag or ecCropName != ""
  print "EC_FAIL: fresh farm must be empty"
else
  print "EC_PASS"

Name: food-recipe-blueprint
Commands:
tell "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor to create "kelp crisp"
assign ecRecipeQueued to "EC Test Kitchen" foodprocessor producing "kelp crisp"
if ecRecipeQueued
  print "EC_PASS"
else
  print "EC_FAIL: kelp crisp blueprint was not queued"
